cite.text: Abits Group Inc · F-1 filed Oct 29, 2026 · Six months ended Jun 30, 2026

analysis: Revenue was $3.2M in H1 2026, down 20% year over year.

Operating profit was $436K, a 13.6% margin (down 39.9 points year over year). Total costs grew 49% against revenue growth of -20%. The fastest-growing cost line was Other operating costs (+212%). The period ended with a net loss of $2.6M. Net interest and other expense of $3.0M was the main reason.

Operating cash flow was −$843K. Non-cash charges added back $2.0M of depreciation and amortization. Working capital and other items used $307K. Capital expenditures of $308K exceeded it, leaving free cash flow of −$1.2M.
